themes.name: AI Compute & GPU
themes.blurb: Merchant accelerators: the chips that train and serve the models, and the cycle everything else in technology is currently priced against.

themes.name: Memory, HBM & DRAM
themes.blurb: The largest divergence in the market: contract prices rising double digits a quarter while the equities fall.

themes.name: Advanced Packaging
themes.blurb: Chips stopped getting faster by shrinking alone. Now they get faster by being stacked — and stacking capacity is the industry's real gate.

themes.name: Semiconductor Capital Equipment
themes.blurb: The tools that build the fabs. Two capex cycles — logic and memory — are now overlapping in the same order books.

themes.name: Datacenter Power & Cooling
themes.blurb: The unglamorous physical constraint. A rack you cannot cool is a rack you cannot deploy, whatever the chip supply looks like.

themes.name: Custom Silicon & ASIC
themes.blurb: The largest buyers of accelerators are trying to stop paying merchant margins. That shift has a supplier, and the supplier is listed.

themes.name: Networking & Optics
themes.blurb: Training clusters are networks first and computers second. The question is whether integrated systems or merchant silicon capture the value.

themes.name: AI Software Monetization
themes.blurb: The layer where AI is supposed to become revenue rather than cost. So far the evidence is thin and the multiples are not.

themes.name: Edge AI Devices
themes.blurb: AI that runs on the device rather than in the datacentre. Structurally attractive, and still without evidence that consumers will pay for it.

themes.name: Sovereign AI
themes.blurb: Governments building national AI capacity. Real money, long timelines, and announcements that considerably outpace deliveries.

themes.name: Robotics & Physical AI
themes.blurb: AI that acts in the physical world. Genuinely large if it works, and currently supported by demonstrations rather than revenue.

themes.name: Quantum & Emerging Compute
themes.blurb: Genuinely important if it arrives, genuinely unpredictable as to when. We cover it to watch it, not to own it.
